target: Metalio E-Ink4-Plus / ESP32-S31 (port of the Read Pico RDP-G01-W / ESP32-S3 build)

metalio.usage: Board pin map, TPS65185 sequence, FT6336U bezel keys, ESP32-S31 LCD/DMA register values, BQ27220/CX25601N battery policy; drivers rewritten on the IDF I2C master API

crossmux.usage: architecture and visual reference; no Arduino dependency

weidu_protocol_reference.usage: Web wire-format and workflow reference; independently authored native C implementation

native_lcd_derivative.changes: Include paths and synchronous per-row phase LUT selection; official scan timing and reference checkout unchanged

thumbnail_jpeg_decoder.license: ChaN permissive terms retained in tjpgd.c
thumbnail_jpeg_decoder.changes: Decoder unchanged; portable stdint header and grayscale/block-scaling configuration. native/src/jpeg_decoder.c and .h namespace public entry points to avoid ESP32-S31 ROM ABI collisions (2026-10-30). The independently authored output adapter in native/src/image_thumbnail.c saturates signed fast-IDCT grayscale values before block averaging to prevent white-to-black wrap (2026-11-02); pinned vendor sources remain unchanged.

shared_application.usage: Shared reader, UI, interaction and thumbnail updates; Metalio BSP, S31 scan path, frontlight, power, audio hardware boundary and OTA board identity retained
shared_application.later_worktree_changes: Reader pagination, jump, input and reader-subpage refresh from the uncommitted 0.3.9 candidate on a509301, inspected 2026-10-27; board adaptation and validation are documented in native/docs/PICO-LATEST-20261027.md. Metalio version remains 0.3.6.

metalio_bluetooth_protocol_reference.usage: BH1098G UART commands, acknowledgements and wiring reference; independently authored worker, parser, persistence and UI. Reference checkout unchanged.

recording_noise_suppression.license: ESPRESSIF MIT (Espressif products only); Apache-2.0 notices retained in interface headers
recording_noise_suppression.usage: Unmodified ESP32-S31 NSNet3 archive, interface headers and model weights. Independently authored single-owner recording adapter and streaming/tail handling; no reference application code copied. Weights are embedded in the main app, not a separate flash partition.

reader_async_tls_poll.usage: native/reader_tls_poll.cmake stages the installed IDF file into build/ and restores select fd_sets before each async connection poll. Upstream SPDX notice is retained; installed SDK and references are unchanged.

ima_openapi_reference.usage: Protocol documentation only; independent native HTTPS cloud streaming and local HTTP pairing UI. Device-local persistent credentials without an unlock password per user decision 2026-10-30. No skill runtime or credentials embedded.

weidu_offline_readtime.boundary: Protocol is an attributed copyleft adaptation; C spool, runtime and device integration are independently authored. Firmware distribution must address combined-work licensing; no publication in this change.

txt_gbk_table_reference.license: ChaN FatFs original permissive license retained in native/vendor/fatfs-txt/LICENSE.txt
txt_gbk_table_reference.usage: GBK/CP936 character mapping; new bounded TXT provider is independently written.

minimp3_psram_adaptation.upstream_revision: Not recorded in the pre-existing vendor snapshot; original file pinned by SHA-256
minimp3_psram_adaptation.changes: Caller-owned checked PSRAM scratch for decode_frame; decoder scratch references adapted, original CC0 notice retained

cubox_cli_reference.note: Protocol endpoints (/c/api/cli/folder/list, /c/api/cli/card/filter, /c/api/cli/card/detail, /c/api/cli/card/update, /c/api/cli/cards/archiving), Bearer token format and APIResponse code==200 envelope referenced from local cubox-cli v1.0.9 MIT release.
cubox_cli_reference.boundary: Independently written in C11 for ThingsOS native firmware; no code copied from Go CLI.
